text: Mobile app development is a complex but rewarding process. One of the first decisions you will make is whether to build a native app for a single platform, like iOS or Android, or to use a cross-platform framework that lets you write one codebase for both. Native apps often offer better performance and smoother animations, but they require more time and money. Cross-platform tools, however, speed up development but may have slight limitations. Regardless of your choice, responsive design is critical. Your app must look and function well on screens of all sizes, from small phones to large tablets. Finally, you will need to publish your finished product through official app stores like Google Play or the Apple App Store, which have their own review processes and guidelines to follow.
